precise_scope: Arbitrary finite real PSD kernel on the decision type X. An actual real feature map is derived from its matrix CFC square root, not assumed and not restricted to a diagonal or special finite-rank fixture.
The posterior variance is the standard latent kernel formula with past Gram matrix, actual cross vector, and positive lambda regularizer, including all repeated inputs.
